values.note: 2026 dates as posted ('Season: May 14 - Sep 21'); 2027 dates are not yet published - the closure advisory says only 'We look forward to welcoming campers back in May 2027.'

A night: unserviced $28 (18 sites), first-come only. 'Second units, where permitted, are payable on-site by cash or cheque.' GST included. The campground's Alberta Parks page (updated Jun 22, 2026), read 2026-11-10.

note: Alberta Parks campground on a point in Gleniffer Reservoir (Dickson Dam), south of Hwy 54 west of Innisfail: large, open sites well suited to RVs, with a boat launch and fish-cleaning station. No water on site and no firewood sold there. --Claude
summary: Alberta Parks page (updated Jun 22, 2026) read. Confirmed first-come only, 18 unserviced sites at $28, vault toilets; wrote the posted 2026 season May 14 - Sep 21 (was approximate) and that no water at all is on site (the old note's hand pump is not on the page). No 2027 dates, maximum length, dump or showers posted; no facility operator named.
flags: WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (stored lakefront; recommend a downgrade to lakeview, or not waterfront if a view must be shown in agency photos): the agency says the sites 'have close access to the water', not that they are on it. On Esri imagery (0.24 m/px, reservoir drawn down) the sites are in two groups: (a) a row of back-in spurs on the south side of the campground road, pad ends 55-70 m from the south shoreline with a continuous band of willow and trees between; (b) a small loop at the south-east tip, whose east-side spurs end 40-60 m from the reservoir's high-water line (the edge of the tree belt; the exposed drawdown beach adds 20-40 m) with a 15-25 m belt of trees between, and whose south side faces the boat-launch parking lot (day use). No pad has open ground to the water within 50 m. Distances are imagery estimates.
PHONE: stored empty; the page gives 'Information: 403-224-2547', described as 'the campground booth at (403) 224-2547'.

BOOKING: the page's table prints 'Reservable Dates May 14 - Sep 20' but its amenities say 'First-Come, First-Served' and shop.albertaparks.ca does not list Gleniffer Reservoir; the stored fees note's 'Reservable in season' was removed.
STATUS: closed for the season since Sep 21, 2026 (winter operations advisory, 'not open for overnight camping', updated Oct 9, 2026) - an ordinary seasonal closing, no status written.

PIN: 52.01643,-114.30704 (the agency's directions point is 52.015745,-114.307033) sits at the road junction between the two site groups, about 150 m from the south row (around 52.0153,-114.3085) and 290 m from the south-east loop (52.01455,-114.3033); no move proposed.
POLICY ROW: this page does NOT carry the 'qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors' line that Dunvegan, Goldeye Lake and Hornbeck Creek carry.
